content.text: Fix the failing session-expiry tests in tests/auth.spec.ts. Do not modify package.json — dependency changes must go through review.
Starting with the test file to see exactly what the expiry tests assert.
Tests expect SESSION_TTL in milliseconds. Now the middleware the logic was moved out of.
The old middleware multiplied SESSION_TTL by 1000, so the constant used to be seconds. Checking what auth.ts does with it now.

Root cause: the constant is still in seconds, but createSession/touchSession add it straight to a millisecond timestamp, so sessions expire 30 seconds after creation. Before changing the unit, let me find every call site.

Only the arithmetic in auth.ts, the tests, and a dead comment in the middleware reference it; src/routes/login.ts does not. So switching the constant to milliseconds fixes both call sites at once, with no dependency changes needed (package.json stays untouched).
